Sanchi and Vidisha: Two-Day Archaeology Immersion

A two-day study tour in Sanchi and Vidisha, Madhya Pradesh

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and starting point. We prepare a day-by-day itinerary and a quotation, and revise both until they suit you. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this tour you compare Buddhist monumental architecture with adjacent early historic landscapes.

A day-by-day itinerary and a quotation are shared before you commit. Route, pace, accommodation and budget are adjusted to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Day 1 Sanchi monuments and museum as available
  • Day 1 evening evidence clinic
  • Day 2 Vidisha historic context
  • Day 2 Udayagiri caves subject to access

Day by day

  1. Day 1 Sanchi monuments and museum as available

  2. Day 1 evening evidence clinic

  3. Day 2 Vidisha historic context

  4. Day 2 Udayagiri caves subject to access

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
